Conversation content on Day 53: [|User|]: Do you have any recommendations for a specific dish to start with as a first-timer?
[|AI|]: As a first-timer, trying the Ethiopian national dish "Injera with different wats" can be a great option. This dish usually has several small portions of stews (wats) that are placed on top of a large injera. The stews are usually made with either beef, chicken, lamb, vegetables, or lentils making it great for vegetarians and meat lovers alike. It's a great introduction to Ethiopian cuisine as it allows you to try a variety of dishes all at once. If you're not sure what to order, don't hesitate to ask the server for recommendations or make a note of the dishes you see being served to other diners.
